MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. Git, JUnit, and Postman. Application performance optimization, scalability, and caching. Cloud-native application development. AI-assisted SDLC tools such as Gemini CLI, Claude, and Codex. 
 Desired Candidate Profile Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Good understanding of distributed systems and enterprise backend architecture. Ability to develop scalable, secure, and high-performing applications. Strong debugging, coding, and troubleshooting capabilities. Good communication and collaboration skills.
